scenicChapters.title: German Fairy Tale Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 36 km this is German Fairy Tale Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

It goes by way of Fort site and civil settlement of Friedber, Watchtowers WP 3/45 to 3/52 including the, Watchtower WP 3/4* and Limessection between watchtowers WP 2/13 a. The line favours views over speed.
